items.quote: And the children of Heth answered Abraham, saying unto him, Hear us, my lord: thou art a mighty prince among us:
items.claim: The children of Heth replied to Abraham and called him a mighty prince among them.

items.quote: in the choice of our sepulchres bury thy dead;
items.claim: The children of Heth told Abraham to bury his dead in whichever of their sepulchres he chose.
items.mechanism: free choice among the Hittites' own sepulchres

items.quote: none of us shall withhold from thee his sepulchre, but that thou mayest bury thy dead.
items.claim: The children of Heth promised that none of them would keep his sepulchre from Abraham, so that he could bury his dead.
